먹기로 했어요.en: I decided / we decided to eat

아침 일곱 시에.es: a las siete de la mañana

texto: **-기로 하다** expresa una decisión o acuerdo de hacer algo: 가다 → **가기로 했어요** (decidí/decidimos ir), 먹다 → **먹기로 했어요**, 하다 → **하기로 했어요**. The form with the form of the decision before the present moment; the subject and whether the decision was individual or group are understood by the context.

**-기로 했어요** reports a decision already made, individual or shared: **친구하고 만나기로 했어요** (I stayed with a friend). **-(으)ㄹ게요** usually communicates the commitment / disposition of the speaker in relation to the interlocutor: **제가 전화할게요** (I will call you).

filas: I decided / we decided to eat

frases.ko: 민수 씨, 주말에 뭐 하기로 했어요?
frases.es: Minsu, ¿qué habíamos decidido hacer el fin de semana?
frases.en: Minsu, what have we decided to do for the weekend?
analisis: what we had decided to do

frases.ko: 우리 다 같이 등산 가기로 했어요.
frases.es: Hemos quedado en ir todos juntos de excursión a la montaña.
frases.en: We've all been left to go on a mountain trip together.
analisis: We've decided to go on a tour.

frases.ko: 아, 맞아요. 몇 시에 만나기로 했어요?
frases.es: Ah, es verdad. ¿A qué hora habíamos quedado?
frases.en: Oh, it's true. What time had we met?

frases.ko: 아침 일곱 시에 역에서 만나기로 했어요.
frases.es: Habíamos quedado a las siete de la mañana en la estación.
frases.en: We'd been meeting at 7: 00 in the morning at the station.

bloques.pregunta: What does «우리 다 같이 등산 가기로 했어요» report?

opciones.texto: That there's already a decision or agreement to go on a tour together.
That they've already done the tour.
opciones.explicacion: That would be the only way.

opciones.texto: That the speaker is offering to go now for someone else.
opciones.explicacion: That commitment would normally be expressed with the United Nations.

opciones.texto: We've decided to do it together.
opciones.explicacion: We have decided to do so.

opciones.texto: We do it together all the time.
What time are you staying today?

opciones.explicacion: That would be the way it was?

bloques.explicacion: In the end, we have left.
